findings.statement: Phase 2 materialized ANIMartRIX at the R1 clock-patched SHA bd9d146e2ce5fde991a895ccc2ad2773df1cc77cb815381679c17c6425d7bbe8 and omitted the R4 transformed header, FastLED source pin, and include directory.
findings.source_ref: Phase 2 runtime regression and exact R4 restoration receipt

findings.statement: The existing R4 helper deterministically transforms that exact R1 header into SHA a2bc03b5196dbaacb39e56885ed9301106b15c4916e0b906f86c02db1601ec1b and uses render_value_fp_from_float within scoped fast-math/O3 controls.

Omission of the exact already-qualified R4 optimization is the smallest evidence-backed cause of the candidate's FPS regression; live runtime confirmation is still required before claiming causal closure.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Apply the existing R4 header transformer to the exact Phase 2 materialized ANIMartRIX header; scope the pinned FastLED src include directory to hbnf_matrix_wled16_max; correct embedded candidate/release strings to WOW-r2.
alternatives_considered: Restore the exact R4 FastLED backport and compiler include closure
Keep the R1 floating point renderer
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The measured FPS regression alone did not prove a missing patch. The built header and build manifests show the R4 transformed input was absent, while the prior R4 runtime and pinned closure establish a compatible mature path. The proposed change restores that path; it does not remove Phase 2 features. A live run remains necessary to establish actual performance on the combined candidate.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: The new artifact grows relative to the rejected image and must be checked against the exact app partition. Runtime frame rate cannot be certified offline.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use the existing R4 helper and exact FastLED pin with a narrowly scoped PlatformIO include path.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: The exact R4 FastLED source closure is required to restore the proven Phase 2 performance baseline before any new bounded runtime qualification.
